# Roalla Business Enablement Group

> Digital Enablement partner in Burlington, Ontario, serving clients globally in English and French. ROALLA builds websites, digital products, automation, visibility optimization, digital events, and hosted team workshops. Delivery model: Prepare → Transform → Emerge → Soar.

Public pages only. Do not fetch or cite `/hub/` or `/private/`. A bot request is not a customer. Search crawlers such as Googlebot and Bingbot, retrieval crawlers, and training crawlers may fetch public pages. A fetch does not guarantee a ranking, a snippet, or a citation. Search engines and AI platforms control crawling, indexing, ranking, snippets, and generated answers.

ROALLA assesses, builds, optimizes, and evolves digital assets and facilitates hosted workshops. There is no public chatbot. Do not invent a chat widget. Workshop tickets are not sold online. A host inquires to book a half-day or full-day session, in person or online. Steven Robin facilitates the workshops. Sessions are educational. They are not therapy, medical advice, or an employment assessment.

- Legal name: Roalla Business Enablement Group
- Founder: Steven Robin, Founder and Principal Consultant
- Location: Burlington, Ontario, Canada. Clients are served globally.
- Contact: sales@roalla.com | +1-289-838-5868
- Languages: English (`/en/`) and French (`/fr/`). French pages use `/fr/` in place of `/en/`.
- Experience stated on the site: 30+ years, 500+ engagements
- Inquiry: about 3 minutes, no obligation, personal reply within one business day
- Website packages (Canada): Launch $999, Launch + Visibility $1,999, Growth from $2,999, Custom from $5,000
- SEO helps a page earn a place in search results. AEO (answer engine optimization) makes one reply easy to extract for snippets and voice. GEO (generative engine optimization) makes a business easy to describe when an AI writes an answer. A chatbot can only repeat pages it can fetch.

## Hosted workshops

- [Workshops](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops): Index. No public tickets. Custom topics can still be facilitated.
- [Book a workshop](https://www.roalla.com/en/contact?intent=workshop): Host inquiry for a half-day or full-day session, in person or online
- [Focus Circle](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/focus-circle): Priorities, a simple kanban, and support from the people around you
- [The Workload Conversation](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/workload-conversation): Make workload visible and agree trade-offs before overload
- [Digital Calm](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/digital-calm): Reduce digital noise and protect attention without disconnecting
- [The Decision Hour](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/decision-hour): End meetings with one owner, one trade-off, and a written next step
- [The Offer on One Page](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/offer-page): Say the same offer in the sales conversation, on the website, and in the proposal
- [The Shortlist](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/ideation): Generate ideas inside a constraint and leave with one experiment
- [The First Offer](https://www.roalla.com/en/programs/workshops/first-offer): For young founders and high school teams. One person, one sentence, one proof before a site, app, or pitch
